format: single THE JOINT chiropractic clinic (leased, 1,000-1,400 sq ft; Franchised Clinic or Managed Clinic)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a THE JOINT ® franchise ranges from $254,250 to $520,800. This includes $40,900 that must be paid to us.

fee.quote: You pay us a nonrefundable $39,900 initial franchise fee, which is due in full at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: Veterans Discount $6,000 ($33,900 fee); Multi-Clinic Discount $10,000 ($29,900 for each additional Clinic); DC Path to Ownership Program $19,900 discount ($20,000 fee). Discounts not combinable. Clinic design fee $1,000 also paid to franchisor at signing.

royalty.flat: Greater of (a) 7% of Gross Sales or (b) $700 per month
royalty.quote: Royalty Fee Greater of (a) 7% of Gross Sales or (b) $700 per month 1st & 16th day of each month. Minimum royalty fee begins 30 days after earlier of Clinic's Required Opening Date or actual opening date.

adFund.quote: Brand Fund Fee Up to 3% of Gross Sales (currently 2%) ... Local Advertising Commitment Greater of (a) 5% of Gross Sales or (b) $3,000 per month
adFund.note: Brand Fund currently 2%, up to 3%. Separate Local Advertising Commitment: greater of 5% of Gross Sales or $3,000 per month spent with third parties (cooperative fees credited toward it). Grand opening advertising $20,000 to $25,000.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Varies (currently $599 per month; may increase to $799 per month on 30 days' notice)

otherRecurring.name: Local Advertising Commitment (minimum)
otherRecurring.amount: Greater of (a) 5% of Gross Sales or (b) $3,000 per month

otherRecurring.name: Conference Registration Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $1,000 per person per day

transferFee.amount: $2,500, $5,000 or $15,000 depending on type of Transfer ... (c) $15,000 for all other completed Transfers

special: Royalty has a floor: greater of 7% of Gross Sales or $700 per month; Local Advertising Commitment is greater of 5% or $3,000 per month on top of the 2% Brand Fund, so total marketing+royalty is at least 14% of Gross Sales. In states that require it, the franchisee only manages the clinic (Managed Clinic) on behalf of a professional corporation that owns the chiropractic practice and employs the chiropractors. Imputed Royalty Fees of $700 per month if opening is delayed past the Required Opening Date.
issues: This is the 2024 FDD (figures for 2023); a newer FDD may exist. Item 19 says Table B-2 covers 29 clinics in the list but the table shows 27; data compiled 'on or prior to March 20, 2023' as printed (likely 2024).
